name: Web Page
description: Show an existing website or public dashboard in a panel. The site must permit embedding. Best used in browser or image mode.

url.title: Page URL
url.description: HTTP(S) address of a public page that permits embedding. Empty shows the sample. This address is sent to displays; use a public or purpose-made display link.

allowScripts.title: Allow page scripts
allowScripts.description: Enable for dashboards that need JavaScript. Embedded content remains isolated from Castboard.

showFooter.title: Show embedding note and open link

displayNotes: Some sites block embedding or require a login. Castboard cannot override that restriction. Scripts and forms are opt-in; embedded content never receives same-origin privileges, top-level navigation or popup access. Pages that need cookies/storage may require a purpose-made public display link. Image mode captures the frame; native mode is a text fallback.
